Priya: Heads up, I pushed marlin-embed-v0.1-int8 to staging and ran our onboarding suite (recall/cluster/equiv tests). Seeing a weird centroid drift for a handful of categories. recall@5 dipped from 0.872 -> 0.843 overall, but some labels drop >6pts. Need quick sanity triage.

Luca: can you paste the per-label breakdown? which clustering algo did you use for the centroid calc?

Priya: Per-label snippet below (subset). I computed centroids using mean of L2-normalized vectors and kmeans with k=200 for coarse buckets.

```
label,baseline_recall@5,marlin_int8_recall@5,delta
faq-billing,0.91,0.84,-0.07
install-troubleshoot,0.89,0.86,-0.03
short-queries,0.72,0.62,-0.10
product-names,0.88,0.87,-0.01
legal-terms,0.94,0.91,-0.03
```

Zoe: short-queries again 4! Any stats on centroid shift magnitude? maybe projection mean changed?

Priya: computed centroid cosine shift per-cluster: mean shift 0.012, tail 99th pct shift 0.045. Also observed increased hubness: top-1 neighbor frequency for a few vectors went from 0.002 -> 0.007.

Luca: interesting. hubness + centroid shift often points to quantization bias in the final projection or token dropout training instability. What quant scheme did you use? per-channel symmetric or dynamic asymmetric?

Priya: marlin int8 build used dynamic asymmetric per-tensor by default because of the conversion script. I did a follow-up run with per-channel symmetric and recall@5 recovered ~0.01 on average but short-queries still poor (0.64 -> hmm).

Zoe: can you run a small ablation: 1) keep projection as fp16 (mixed-precision), 2) per-channel symmetric int8 + bias-correction (subtract mean across rows before quant), 3) whitening + l2 norm vs baseline (sanity). Which is fastest to queue?

Priya: queued 1 & 2. CI job IDs: ci-bot queued jobs 3739994445 (mixed-prec-proj) and 3739994446 (perchannel-biascorr).

ci-bot: Job 3739994445 started on staging-run-87. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/3739994445.

Luca: nice. Also add a tiny synthetic probe: duplicate very-short queries (1-3 tokens) with paraphrase noise to simulate alias effect. We suspect the projection outputs collapse near center after quantization, increasing nearest neighbor collisions.

Priya: did that quick probe: baseline short-query mean norm=0.92, marlin-int8 mean norm=0.61. Mixed-prec projection mean norm=0.89. So projection fp16 looks promising for norms.

Zoe: good signal. If mixed-precision fixes norm collapse, we should consider shipping a rollback-safe routing rule: route queries with len<=3 to heron-prod until we fix quant pipeline. That buys time.

Luca: agree. Also let's capture recall@5 stratified by query length and by cluster-popularity (heavy vs long-tail buckets). Priya can you dump per-query neighbor ranks and the top-5 ids for a random sample of 500 short queries?

Priya: yes, saving artifacts. Upload link once CI finishes. Planning to attach per-query CSV + tiny visualization of norm distribution shift.

ci-bot: Job 3739994446 finished 12 artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/3739994446. Summary: per-channel bias-corr recovered avg recall@5 to 0.856; short-query recall@5 improved to 0.66.

Priya: summary so far: marlin-int8 (default per-tensor dyn asym) = recall@5 0.843, per-channel sym = 0.853, per-channel + bias-corr = 0.856, mixed-prec projection = 0.868 (nearly baseline). Latency delta for mixed-prec projection on staging ~ +3.8% p50; cost delta negligible for our infra (FP16 on GPU).

Zoe: that's actionable. Proposed next steps: 1) if mixed-prec projection passes nightly stability, promote mixed-prec as the int8 default for marlin; 2) add bias-corr option to quantization script as fallback; 3) implement temporary routing for len<=3 to heron-prod in Redwood routing rules.

Luca: also file an internal issue to fix the conversion script that forced per-tensor dyn asymmetric without a flag. That's the root cause.

Priya: opened GH #4823 with details and linked CI runs. Will post full artifacts later.

Zoe: great work. tagging @Luca for follow-up on routing policy and @ci-bot for nightly run. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Nightly run scheduled for 3740000000 with mixed-precision projection enabled on staging.

Priya: thanks all 3; will close after nightly completes and I'll post final diff + plot attachments.
